rule_text: MRI prior authorization for back pain. Apply the conditions in order and stop at the first that matches: (1) If the patient's plan is inactive, recommend Deny. (2) If the note explicitly says back pain has lasted less than 6 weeks, or physiotherapy was tried for less than 6 weeks, recommend Deny. (3) If the note does not establish the duration of back pain or of physiotherapy, recommend Need more information. (4) Otherwise, recommend Approve. Exactly 6 weeks meets the requirement. 'No physiotherapy was tried' means 0 weeks. Physiotherapy that is not mentioned, or mentioned without a duration, has a duration of null. Other treatments do not count as physiotherapy.
evaluation_order: pain_weeks is null or physio_weeks is null -> Need more information
